text: Develop flexibility. When plans fall apart, don’t dig in your heels. Imagine that you are a river encountering a boulder on its path. The river does not try to break it; it simply flows around it. Water is the element of the second chakra. Flexibility of body, mind, and character is a single quality. The ability to easily change course in response to external circumstances is a sign of youth and a key skill for social adaptation and prosperity. Begin self-development with asanas for flexibility—it’s simpler and logical that way :)
